mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.appeal_no, a.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.credit_score, u.credit_level, a.credit_log_id, l.action_code, cr.rule_name AS action_name, l.score_change AS log_score_change, l.reason AS log_reason, l.create_time AS log_time, a.order_id, o.order_no, a.appeal_reason, a.status, a.handle_user_id, hu.real_name AS handle_user_name, a.handle_time, a.handle_remark, a.restore_score, a.create_time FROM credit_appeal a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN credit_log l ON l.id = a.credit_log_id LEFT JOIN credit_rule cr ON cr.rule_type = 'ACTION' AND cr.rule_code = l.action_code AND cr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lease_order o ON o.id = a.order_id LEFT JOIN sys_user hu ON hu.id = a.handle_user_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
